title: P15.9-A1 R3b: org-wide strict-read enumeration — raw business_id prefilter bypass closed
description: R3 residual on PR #91 (BASE e24e334); R1/R2/R3 preserved. businessCompany previously called objectives.list(businessId) — a raw business_id prefilter BEFORE strict validation, so an objective whose business_id was tampered vanished from the company read without failing closed. Now the projection enumerates ALL objective rows unscoped, strict-reads every one via objectives.get (canonical row + digest + anchor proof; business_id is digest-bound so a forge fails closed), and only then filters by the PROVEN canonical business_id + owner. Scope consequence (documented, no smaller honest alternative): the read is org-wide fail-closed — one corrupt objective anywhere fails every company read. R3-F2 pin-freshness unchanged. Tests 26/26 incl. adversarial business_id tamper between two businesses — both source and target company reads fail closed; all prior negatives preserved. No authority-semantics change; no UI/A2; no CEO/Router/Executor/KPI/Telegram. No merge/deploy.
